create_DatasetAssign: create a DatasetAssign wrapper for a PyTorch tensor to assign vectors to centroids using FAISS k-NN search
run_DatasetAssign_assign_to: run assign_to on a DatasetAssign instance to get cluster assignments, distances, and centroid sums
create_DatasetAssignGPU: create a DatasetAssignGPU wrapper that performs GPU-accelerated k-NN search for assigning vectors to centroids
run_kmeans: run the kmeans function imported from faiss.contrib.clustering to compute centroids for a dataset
review_DatasetAssign_perform_search: review the DatasetAssign perform_search method to understand how FAISS k-NN is used for nearest centroid lookup
